citation.authors: Hessefort Y, Holland BT, Cloud RW

record.design: Gas sorption measurement of true pore volume and surface area in damaged hair
record.finding: Bleach damage and UV damage change hair porosity by different pathways; bleach nearly triples surface area in the first minute, then it falls, while UV damage shows an immediate loss then gradual increase. This defines porosity as a measurable pore property of the fibre.
record.note: Not afro-textured hair specifically; the abstract does not give hair types.
